title: Science from the bottom up
abstract: How a scientific community is organized can affect whether disagreement drives progress or leads to isolation. Students and postdocs are uniquely placed to build communities that bridge theoretical and methodological divides. Drawing on a student-led society in consciousness science, we show how empowering early-career researchers can turn fragmentation into collaboration.
abstract_zh: 科学社区的组织方式会影响分歧是推动进步还是导致孤立。学生和博士后在构建跨理论与方法学鸿沟的社区方面具有独特优势。以意识科学领域的学生主导学会为例，我们展示了赋予早期职业研究者权力如何将碎片化转化为合作。
